title_en: can, could, be able to, may, might, must and can’t (Exercises 65–72)
title_vi: can, could, be able to, may, might, must và can’t
theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 65: Choose the correct alternative (can, could and be able to).

Bài 65: Chọn phương án đúng (can, could và be able to).

Exercise 66: Tick the best sentence in each pair, or tick both if both are possible.

Bài 66: Đánh dấu câu đúng nhất trong mỗi cặp, hoặc cả hai nếu đều được.

Exercise 67: Answer the questions with might or might have and the ideas in brackets.

Bài 67: Trả lời câu hỏi với might hoặc might have và ý trong ngoặc.

Exercise 68: Use might to complete the sentences which explain why you should follow this advice.

Bài 68: Dùng might hoàn thành câu giải thích vì sao nên làm theo lời khuyên.

Exercise 69: Match the beginning of each sentence with the most suitable ending.

Bài 69: Nối phần đầu mỗi câu với phần cuối phù hợp nhất.

Exercise 70: Complete the email with the words from the box.

Bài 70: Hoàn thành email bằng các từ trong khung.

Exercise 71: Choose the correct alternative.

Bài 71: Chọn phương án đúng.

Exercise 72: Complete the answers with must, can’t or might and any other words you need.

Bài 72: Hoàn thành câu trả lời bằng must, can’t hoặc might và các từ cần thiết.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 26–30 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 26–30 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: Why did you walk from the station? You ___ me for a lift.
mcq.full: Why did you walk from the station? You could have phoned me for a lift.
mcq.vi: Sao bạn đi bộ từ ga về? Lẽ ra bạn có thể gọi tôi đón.
mcq.expl:
could have + past participle = possible but didn’t happen; could = general ability / permission in the past; was able to = managed to do something in a particular situation.
could have + quá khứ phân từ = đã có thể nhưng không làm; could = khả năng / sự cho phép chung trong quá khứ; was able to = làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Có thể nhưng đã không làm → could have + p.p.
mcq.key: Why did you walk from the station? You ___ me for a lift.|could have phoned

mcq.question: They let me read all their books and told me I ___ to bed as late as I wanted.
mcq.full: They let me read all their books and told me I could go to bed as late as I wanted.
mcq.vi: Ông bà cho tôi đọc hết sách và bảo tôi được đi ngủ muộn tùy thích.
mcq.expl:
could have + past participle = possible but didn’t happen; could = general ability / permission in the past; was able to = managed to do something in a particular situation.
could have + quá khứ phân từ = đã có thể nhưng không làm; could = khả năng / sự cho phép chung trong quá khứ; was able to = làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sự cho phép chung → could.
mcq.key: They let me read all their books and told me I ___ to bed as late as I wanted.|could go

mcq.question: This carpet was priced at £500, but I ___ a discount because of this little mark in the corner.
mcq.full: This carpet was priced at £500, but I was able to get a discount because of this little mark in the corner.
mcq.vi: Tấm thảm này giá 500 bảng, nhưng tôi được giảm giá vì vết bẩn nhỏ ở góc.
mcq.expl:
could have + past participle = possible but didn’t happen; could = general ability / permission in the past; was able to = managed to do something in a particular situation.
could have + quá khứ phân từ = đã có thể nhưng không làm; could = khả năng / sự cho phép chung trong quá khứ; was able to = làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Làm được trong tình huống cụ thể → was able to.
mcq.key: This carpet was priced at £500, but I ___ a discount because of this little mark in the corner.|was able to get

mcq.question: I ___ online all morning. It’s making my life impossible!
mcq.full: I haven’t been able to get online all morning. It’s making my life impossible!
mcq.vi: Tôi không vào mạng được cả buổi sáng. Thật khổ sở!
mcq.expl:
could have + past participle = possible but didn’t happen; could = general ability / permission in the past; was able to = managed to do something in a particular situation.
could have + quá khứ phân từ = đã có thể nhưng không làm; could = khả năng / sự cho phép chung trong quá khứ; was able to = làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Đến giờ → haven’t been able to.
mcq.key: I ___ online all morning. It’s making my life impossible!|haven’t been able to get

mcq.question: I’ve no idea where my brother is now. He ___ at the North Pole for all I know.
mcq.full: I’ve no idea where my brother is now. He could be at the North Pole for all I know.
mcq.vi: Tôi không biết anh tôi giờ ở đâu. Có khi anh ấy đang ở Bắc Cực cũng nên.
mcq.expl:
could have + past participle = possible but didn’t happen; could = general ability / permission in the past; was able to = managed to do something in a particular situation.
could have + quá khứ phân từ = đã có thể nhưng không làm; could = khả năng / sự cho phép chung trong quá khứ; was able to = làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Khả năng hiện tại → could be.
mcq.key: I’ve no idea where my brother is now. He ___ at the North Pole for all I know.|could be

mcq.question: It’s hard to imagine how scientists cope with the Antarctic climate. I’m sure I ___.
mcq.full: It’s hard to imagine how scientists cope with the Antarctic climate. I’m sure I couldn’t.
mcq.vi: Khó tưởng tượng các nhà khoa học chịu đựng khí hậu Nam Cực thế nào. Chắc chắn tôi không thể chịu nổi.
mcq.expl:
could have + past participle = possible but didn’t happen; could = general ability / permission in the past; was able to = managed to do something in a particular situation.
could have + quá khứ phân từ = đã có thể nhưng không làm; could = khả năng / sự cho phép chung trong quá khứ; was able to = làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Giả định → couldn’t.
mcq.key: It’s hard to imagine how scientists cope with the Antarctic climate. I’m sure I ___.|couldn’t

mcq.question: We ___ in our holiday flat, but we preferred to eat out.
mcq.full: We could have cooked in our holiday flat, but we preferred to eat out.
mcq.vi: Lẽ ra chúng tôi có thể nấu ăn ở căn hộ nghỉ dưỡng, nhưng chúng tôi thích ăn ngoài hơn.
mcq.expl:
could have + past participle = possible but didn’t happen; could = general ability / permission in the past; was able to = managed to do something in a particular situation.
could have + quá khứ phân từ = đã có thể nhưng không làm; could = khả năng / sự cho phép chung trong quá khứ; was able to = làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Có thể nhưng đã không làm → could have + p.p.
mcq.key: We ___ in our holiday flat, but we preferred to eat out.|could have cooked

mcq.question: I broke my new necklace but luckily my sister ___ fix it for me.
mcq.full: I broke my new necklace but luckily my sister was able to fix it for me.
mcq.vi: Tôi làm đứt sợi dây chuyền mới nhưng may là chị tôi đã sửa được.
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Làm được trong tình huống cụ thể → was able to.
mcq.key: I broke my new necklace but luckily my sister ___ fix it for me.|was able to

mcq.question: Emily was with Tom when her phone was stolen, so she ___ use his to call me.
mcq.full: Emily was with Tom when her phone was stolen, so she was able to use his to call me.
mcq.vi: Emily đi cùng Tom khi bị mất điện thoại, nên cô ấy đã dùng được máy của Tom gọi cho tôi.
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tình huống cụ thể → was able to.
mcq.key: Emily was with Tom when her phone was stolen, so she ___ use his to call me.|was able to

mcq.question: In the end, Marion ___ come with us because her meeting was cancelled.
mcq.full: In the end, Marion was able to come with us because her meeting was cancelled.
mcq.vi: Cuối cùng Marion đã đi được cùng chúng tôi vì cuộc họp bị hủy.
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tình huống cụ thể → was able to.
mcq.key: In the end, Marion ___ come with us because her meeting was cancelled.|was able to

mcq.question: Toby ___ Dutch when he arrived in Holland, but he’s almost fluent now.
mcq.full: Toby couldn’t speak Dutch when he arrived in Holland, but he’s almost fluent now.
mcq.vi: Toby không nói được tiếng Hà Lan khi mới đến, nhưng giờ gần như thành thạo.
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Khả năng chung → couldn’t.
mcq.key: Toby ___ Dutch when he arrived in Holland, but he’s almost fluent now.|couldn’t speak

mcq.question: I’d planned to get a taxi after the party, but luckily I ___ have a lift with Kate.
mcq.full: I’d planned to get a taxi after the party, but luckily I was able to have a lift with Kate.
mcq.vi: Tôi định đi taxi sau bữa tiệc, nhưng may là được đi nhờ xe Kate.
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tình huống cụ thể → was able to.
mcq.key: I’d planned to get a taxi after the party, but luckily I ___ have a lift with Kate.|was able to

mcq.question: My brother ___ read well by the age of seven, but he had problems with maths.
mcq.full: My brother could read well by the age of seven, but he had problems with maths.
mcq.vi: Anh tôi đọc được tốt từ năm bảy tuổi, nhưng gặp khó với toán.
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Khả năng chung → could.
mcq.key: My brother ___ read well by the age of seven, but he had problems with maths.|could

mcq.question: When we turned off the light inside, we ___ see a fox by the rubbish bin.
mcq.full: When we turned off the light inside, we could see a fox by the rubbish bin.
mcq.vi: Khi tắt đèn trong nhà, chúng tôi nhìn thấy một con cáo cạnh thùng rác.
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: could + see.
mcq.key: When we turned off the light inside, we ___ see a fox by the rubbish bin.|could

mcq.question: I locked my sister out of the house by mistake, but luckily she ___ get in through an open window!
mcq.full: I locked my sister out of the house by mistake, but luckily she was able to get in through an open window!
mcq.vi: Tôi lỡ khóa em gái ở ngoài, nhưng may là em ấy đã vào được qua cửa sổ mở!
mcq.expl:
For a particular achievement in the past use was / were able to (not could); couldn’t is possible in both cases; could for general ability and with see / hear.
Với việc làm được trong một tình huống cụ thể trong quá khứ dùng was / were able to (không dùng could); couldn’t dùng được cả hai; could cho khả năng chung và với see / hear.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tình huống cụ thể → was able to.
mcq.key: I locked my sister out of the house by mistake, but luckily she ___ get in through an open window!|was able to

mcq.question: What flavour ice cream shall we buy for Liz? – She ___ chocolate.
mcq.full: What flavour ice cream shall we buy for Liz? – She might prefer chocolate.
mcq.vi: Mua kem vị gì cho Liz nhỉ? – Có khi cô ấy thích sô-cô-la hơn.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might + nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: What flavour ice cream shall we buy for Liz? – She ___ chocolate.|might prefer

mcq.question: Why is Alan in such a bad mood today? – He ___ badly last night.
mcq.full: Why is Alan in such a bad mood today? – He might have slept badly last night.
mcq.vi: Sao hôm nay Alan cáu thế? – Có thể tối qua anh ấy ngủ không ngon.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might have + p.p. (quá khứ).
mcq.key: Why is Alan in such a bad mood today? – He ___ badly last night.|might have slept

mcq.question: Why didn’t Jane come to the party with her boyfriend last night? – They ___ a row.
mcq.full: Why didn’t Jane come to the party with her boyfriend last night? – They might have had a row.
mcq.vi: Sao tối qua Jane không đi tiệc cùng bạn trai? – Có thể họ đã cãi nhau.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might have + p.p.
mcq.key: Why didn’t Jane come to the party with her boyfriend last night? – They ___ a row.|might have had

mcq.question: Why is Anna looking under the desk? – She ___ something.
mcq.full: Why is Anna looking under the desk? – She might have dropped something.
mcq.vi: Sao Anna nhìn dưới gầm bàn? – Có thể cô ấy đánh rơi gì đó.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might have + p.p.
mcq.key: Why is Anna looking under the desk? – She ___ something.|might have dropped

mcq.question: I can’t remember where I put my bag. – It ___ under the bed.
mcq.full: I can’t remember where I put my bag. – It might be under the bed.
mcq.vi: Tôi không nhớ để túi ở đâu. – Có khi nó ở dưới gầm giường.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might be (hiện tại).
mcq.key: I can’t remember where I put my bag. – It ___ under the bed.|might be

mcq.question: Why hasn’t anybody said ‘Happy Birthday’ to me? – They ___ a surprise.
mcq.full: Why hasn’t anybody said ‘Happy Birthday’ to me? – They might be planning a surprise.
mcq.vi: Sao chẳng ai chúc mừng sinh nhật tôi? – Có khi họ đang chuẩn bị bất ngờ.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might be + -ing.
mcq.key: Why hasn’t anybody said ‘Happy Birthday’ to me? – They ___ a surprise.|might be planning

mcq.question: Why does Henry look so miserable? – He ___ some bad news.
mcq.full: Why does Henry look so miserable? – He might have had some bad news.
mcq.vi: Sao Henry trông buồn thế? – Có thể anh ấy vừa nhận tin xấu.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might have + p.p.
mcq.key: Why does Henry look so miserable? – He ___ some bad news.|might have had

mcq.question: Why isn’t Sophie in the office today? – She ___ at home.
mcq.full: Why isn’t Sophie in the office today? – She might be working at home.
mcq.vi: Sao hôm nay Sophie không ở văn phòng? – Có thể cô ấy đang làm việc ở nhà.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might be + -ing.
mcq.key: Why isn’t Sophie in the office today? – She ___ at home.|might be working

mcq.question: Why didn’t Rosie come to the cinema last night? – She ___ something better to do.
mcq.full: Why didn’t Rosie come to the cinema last night? – She might have had something better to do.
mcq.vi: Sao tối qua Rosie không đi xem phim? – Có thể cô ấy có việc khác hay hơn.
mcq.expl:
might + infinitive (present / future possibility); might have + past participle (past possibility).
might + nguyên mẫu (khả năng hiện tại / tương lai); might have + quá khứ phân từ (khả năng trong quá khứ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: might have + p.p.
mcq.key: Why didn’t Rosie come to the cinema last night? – She ___ something better to do.|might have had

mcq.question: You should reserve a seat on the train for long journeys. If you don’t, you ___ to stand all the way.
mcq.full: You should reserve a seat on the train for long journeys. If you don’t, you might have to stand all the way.
mcq.vi: Bạn nên đặt chỗ khi đi tàu đường dài. Nếu không, bạn có thể phải đứng suốt.
mcq.expl:
If you don’t …, you might … = a possible bad result.
If you don’t …, you might … = một hậu quả xấu có thể xảy ra.
Điểm ngữ pháp: might + nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: You should reserve a seat on the train for long journeys. If you don’t, you ___ to stand all the way.|might have

mcq.question: You’d better not leave your laptop in the garden. If you do, someone ___ it.
mcq.full: You’d better not leave your laptop in the garden. If you do, someone might steal it.
mcq.vi: Đừng để laptop ngoài vườn. Nếu để, có thể ai đó lấy trộm mất.
mcq.expl:
If you don’t …, you might … = a possible bad result.
If you don’t …, you might … = một hậu quả xấu có thể xảy ra.
Điểm ngữ pháp: might + nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: You’d better not leave your laptop in the garden. If you do, someone ___ it.|might steal

mcq.question: You must have met some fascinating people ___.
mcq.c: when you’ve just had a nap
mcq.full: You must have met some fascinating people during your trip to Africa.
mcq.vi: Chắc bạn đã gặp nhiều người thú vị trong chuyến đi châu Phi.
mcq.expl:
must / can’t (have) for deductions; may / might / could for possibilities and suggestions.
must / can’t (have) cho suy luận chắc chắn; may / might / could cho khả năng và gợi ý.
Điểm ngữ pháp: must have + p.p. (suy luận quá khứ).
mcq.key: You must have met some fascinating people ___.|during your trip to Africa

mcq.question: You must know Tokyo is expensive ___.
mcq.full: You must know Tokyo is expensive because you’ve lived there.
mcq.vi: Chắc bạn biết Tokyo đắt đỏ vì bạn đã sống ở đó.
mcq.expl:
must / can’t (have) for deductions; may / might / could for possibilities and suggestions.
must / can’t (have) cho suy luận chắc chắn; may / might / could cho khả năng và gợi ý.
Điểm ngữ pháp: must (suy luận).
mcq.key: You must know Tokyo is expensive ___.|because you’ve lived there

mcq.question: You can’t have lived in Tunisia for ten years ___.
mcq.full: You can’t have lived in Tunisia for ten years without learning some Arabic.
mcq.vi: Bạn không thể đã sống ở Tunisia mười năm mà không học chút tiếng Ả Rập.
